pricing.title: Kōwhiria tō Mahere
pricing.subtitle: Hangaia ngā taupānga katoa mā te AI. Kei ia mahere tō mātou paipa kaihoko-maha. Ka pau ngā nama i ia wāhanga hanganga (Kaimahere, Kaiwaehere, Kaiarotake).
pricing.freeDesc: Mō te hunga ngahau e tūhura ana i te hanga taupānga AI
pricing.starterDesc: Taumata utu tuatahi mō ngā kaihanga takitahi
pricing.builderDesc: Mō ngā mātanga takitahi e kaha ana
pricing.studioDesc: Ngā tīma me ngā taiwhanga ngaio
pricing.enterpriseDesc: Ngā whakahaere nui me ngā hiahia ritenga
pricing.enterpriseF1: Hanganga me ngā nama mutunga kore
pricing.buyTitle: Kua pau ngā nama? Hokona ētahi atu
pricing.buySubtitle: $1 te utu o ia nama tāpiri. Ka tāpiri ki tō toenga i muri tonu i te utu, ka whakakore hoki i te okiokinga o ngā hanganga.
pricing.howTitle: Pēhea ngā Nama e Mahi ai
pricing.howIntro: Ka rere ia hanganga i tētahi paipa AI e 3 ngā wāhanga. Ka pau ngā nama i ia wāhanga:
pricing.howFooter: E 6 ngā nama o te hanganga katoa (2 + 3 + 1). Ki te pau i waenganui, ka okioki tō kaupapa, ā, ka taea e koe te tāpiri nama, te whakapai ake rānei i tō mahere. Ka pūmau ngā nama kāore i whakamahia mō ngā rā 30.
pricing.creditsNote: Ka rāhuitia {buildCost} nama mō ia hanganga ina tīmata. E {seniorCost} ngā nama mō ngā wātaka Kaiwaehere Matua. He hokonga te Hinonga — whakapā mai i raro (kāore he utu-a-kiri).
pricing.checkoutNoUrl: Kāore i whakahokia he URL utu.

credits.title: Kua pau ngā nama — kua okioki te mahi
credits.body: E {credits} ō nama; e {cost} e hiahiatia ana kia {action}. Ka okioki ngā hanganga kia haina, kia hoko nama tāpiri rānei koe.

footer.ownerOf: Owner of AppForge and TrillionAI Tech

about.title: About AppForge
about.body: AppForge is the AI app builder from TrillionAI Tech. Anselm Perkins is Founder & CEO and owner of AppForge and TrillionAI Tech.

landing.metaTitle: Hangaia ngā taupānga katoa mā te AI
landing.metaDesc: Ka huri a AppForge i ngā whakaaro ki waehere whakaputa mā ngā paipa kaihoko-maha.
landing.heroTitle: Waihangatia ngā taupānga whakaputa mā ngā kaihoko AI
landing.heroSubtitle: Whakaahuatia tō whakaaro. Ka whakamahere, waehere, arotake, tuku hoki a AppForge — me ngā tātauira, utu, me ngā utauta tīma.
landing.featuresTitle: Ngā mea katoa e hiahiatia ana kia tuku
landing.featuresSubtitle: Mai i te tono tuatahi ki te tuku whakaputa — kotahi te papa.
landing.howSubtitle: E toru ngā hipanga mai i te whakaaro ki te taupānga ora.
landing.howStep1Body: Kōrero ki a AppForge ngā mea e hiahia ana koe — kāheu, āhuatanga, me ngā hiahia hoahoa.
landing.howStep2Body: Ka waihanga me te whakaū ngā kaihoko Kaimahere, Kaiwaehere, me Kaiarotake i te waehere whakaputa.
landing.howStep3Body: Tuku kotahi-pāwhiri, whirihora utu, tātaritanga, me te mahi tahi ā-tīma.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Tīmata koreutu. Whakapai ake ina rite koe ki te tuku.
landing.pricingBlurb: Kei te taumata koreutu e 3 hanganga/marama. Ka tāpiri ngā mahere utu i ngā nama, rārangi matua, me ngā āhuatanga tīma.
landing.trustedBy: E whakawhirinakitia ana e ngā kaihanga puta noa i te ao

faq.q1: He aha ngā kāheu e tautokona ana e AppForge?
faq.q1A: React, Next.js, Vue, tātaritanga pūkoro, API, kēmu, me ngā taiwhanga toronga.
faq.q2: Ka taea e au te kaweake i taku waehere?
faq.q2A: Āe — kaweake ki GitHub, tuku ki Fly.io, Vercel rānei i ngā wā katoa.
faq.q3: Pēhea ngā nama e mahi ai?
faq.q3A: Ka pau ngā nama i ia wāhanga hanganga. Ka pūmau ngā nama kāore i whakamahia mō ngā rā 30.
